clue.text: European copper's endless love for a Pacific state

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: endless says the word for love loses its final letter

parts.note: to love is to adore

explanation.surface: A Continental policeman's fading romance with an island nation in the Pacific.
explanation.definitionFit: This South American republic has a Pacific coastline, so it is a state on that ocean.

clue.text: Imagine losing one when shaking riddle!

indicators.note: when shaking signals the remaining letters are tossed into a new order

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: Picture someone losing a unit while trembling over a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' takes I from IMAGINE, and 'when shaking' rearranges MAGINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A puzzling question or mystery is a conundrum.

clue.text: Universal scheme duke suggested initially for hills

parts.note: U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal
a plan is a scheme

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An aristocrat first proposed a plan for the whole world, for the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: High ground or hill country is the region away from the plains.

clue.text: Drug wrapped in Norfolk doctor's extremely large cloak?

indicators.note: wrapped in says the drug letter is enclosed between town and doctor

parts.note: Diss is a market town in Norfolk, an English county
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: extremely picks out the outermost letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A narcotic is concealed in a huge coat belonging to a physician from East Anglia.
explanation.definitionFit: To dissemble is to hide one's real feelings, as a cloak hides; the question mark flags the verb.

clue.text: Male soldiers standing in line

indicators.note: standing in means the soldiers are placed inside the line

parts.note: Ry is an abbreviation for railway, a line
OR, other ranks, is short for soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A man watches troops queue up.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a common boy's name, so it fits a male person.

clue.text: Goldsmith's fine English overwhelming a note-writer

indicators.note: overwhelming means the first pair of letters surrounds and swamps what follows

parts.note: F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine
Alban Berg was a composer, someone who writes musical notes

explanation.surface: A goldsmith's fine Englishman drowns out someone who writes letters.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Goldsmith stands for 'is'. 'note-writer' suggests a letter-writer but means a composer of music.
explanation.definitionFit: Carl Fabergé was the Russian jeweller famous for his gold and enamelled eggs.

clue.text: Italian girl's charge for lodging in east

parts.note: Flo is a short girl's name
rent is the charge for living somewhere
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl pays to stay in accommodation in the east.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Florence is an Italian.

clue.text: Key of some rumbas I composed

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Musical key of some rumba pieces I have written.
explanation.definitionFit: Something key is fundamental or essential, a core quality.

clue.text: Hair feature right for son in vest

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of another

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest

explanation.surface: A hairstyle is fine for a lad in a sleeveless top.
explanation.definitionFit: A curl or lock of hair is a hair feature.

clue.text: Cause of death of former RAF officers on river?

parts.note: ex means former
POs are pilot officers in the RAF
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Ex-airmen died after being stationed beside water.
explanation.definitionFit: Being left out in the cold elements can kill through hypothermia.

clue.text: Eminent state university plugging American chamber groups

parts.note: Ill. is the abbreviation for the US state of Illinois

indicators.note: plugging means the university letter is stuffed into the gap in the groups

parts.note: trios are small groups playing chamber music

explanation.surface: A distinguished college is placed among American chamber ensembles.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone famous and highly respected.

clue.text: Game in vessel going west

indicators.note: going west in an across clue means read from right to left, backwards

parts.note: a pan is a cooking vessel

explanation.surface: A game played aboard a ship sailing westward.
explanation.definitionFit: Nap, short for Napoleon, is a trick-taking card game.

clue.text: Does one move affectedly when grinding meat?

definitions.text: Does one move affectedly when grinding meat?

parts.words: Does one move affectedly when grinding meat
parts.note: one who minces walks with prissy steps; the same name is given to a kitchen machine that chops meat finely

explanation.surface: A butcher wonders whether working the meat makes them walk daintily.
explanation.definitionFit: To mince is both to walk affectedly and to chop meat finely, and the machine for the latter bears the agent name.

clue.text: She unexpectedly keeps cash back for a labourer

indicators.note: keeps means the shuffled letters hold another piece inside them
unexpectedly signals the letters of She are put in a surprising order

parts.note: the three letters are rearranged

indicators.note: back means the money word is read in reverse

parts.note: lucre is a slang word for money

explanation.surface: A woman surprisingly hoards money for a working man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unexpectedly' makes HES from She, which 'keeps' ERCUL, 'back' turning LUCRE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek hero was set twelve labours, so he is the classic labourer of myth.

clue.text: Serve as farm-worker, another being late

parts.note: to be is to serve as
a hind is an old word for a farm labourer
a hand is another farm labourer

explanation.surface: Work as a farm labourer while another one arrives behind schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Behindhand means behind time or delayed.

clue.text: Book content making citizen count for something

parts.note: a subject is a citizen of a monarchy
to matter is to be important, to count for something

explanation.surface: What makes a citizen feel significant is a book's contents.
explanation.definitionFit: The topic a book deals with is its substance or theme.

clue.text: Attendants having a weep about concert

indicators.note: about means the weep word goes round the attendants

parts.note: greet is a Scottish word for weep
men are attendants or servants

explanation.surface: Ushers cry at a musical performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means acting in harmony or accord.

clue.text: Urbane person's yoghurt drink

definitions.meaning: a blended fruit drink often made with yoghurt

explanation.surface: A suave man's favourite drink is a creamy blended one.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a slick charmer and a thick blended drink.

clue.text: Charismatic old PM with an attractive property?

parts.note: a magnetic personality is charismatic
Lord North was British Prime Minister during the American War of Independence

explanation.surface: A charming former prime minister owns a desirable house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attractive property' reads as a nice house, but it means the point a compass needle is drawn to.
explanation.definitionFit: It is where a compass needle points, a place defined by magnetic attraction.

clue.text: Ageing convict serving bird

parts.note: grey describes someone getting old
a lag is a convict, an old lag

explanation.surface: An elderly prisoner doing time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serving' and 'bird' suggest a prison sentence, 'bird' being slang for jail time, but bird is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The greylag is a grey wild goose.

clue.text: How to prevent this girl getting hypothermia?

definitions.text: How to prevent this girl getting hypothermia?

parts.words: How to prevent this girl getting hypothermia
parts.note: keeping her warm is the remedy, and the instruction to do so read as one word is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Advice on keeping a young woman from freezing.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a woman's name, and split in two it is the instruction to warm a female.

clue.text: Yarn wife kept in fish basket

indicators.note: kept in means the wife letter is placed inside the basket

parts.note: a creel is an angler's basket

explanation.surface: A tale about a wife kept in a fishing basket.
explanation.definitionFit: Crewel is a fine worsted yarn used in embroidery.

clue.text: Set aside blunder in Roman poet's note

indicators.note: in means the mistake word sits inside the poet's name

parts.note: Ovid was a Roman poet
to err is to make a mistake
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses an error found in a classical poet's jotting.
explanation.definitionFit: To override a decision is to set it aside or overrule it.

clue.text: Dirty old man pinching Meg's bottom, for example?

definitions.text: Dirty old man pinching Meg's bottom, for example?

indicators.note: pinching means the man takes hold of a letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a roué is a debauched, lecherous man

indicators.note: bottom picks the last letter of the word in a down clue

explanation.surface: A lecher gropes a woman's behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a scoundrel is a rascal or villain.

clue.text: Match up, say, socks to darn?

definitions.meaning: to pair socks again after washing
to darn is to mend a hole

explanation.surface: Sorting odd socks into pairs, then mending the holes.
explanation.definitionFit: Mending a hole, as in darning, is a kind of mending or fixing work.

clue.text: Superstar lacking employment on radio

indicators.note: on radio means a word heard spoken, matching the sound of another

parts.note: idle means without work

explanation.surface: A celebrity is out of work and on the airwaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A hero or star is adored as an idol.

clue.text: Not entirely healthy, the future Henry V

indicators.note: not entirely says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: hale means robustly healthy

explanation.surface: The young prince who would become Henry V was not altogether well.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Prince Hal is the youthful nickname of the king-to-be.

clue.text: Young relative's £1,000 cut blocked by retired writer

indicators.note: blocked by means the money and the cut are separated by something wedged between them

parts.note: a grand is slang for a thousand pounds
to hew is to cut

indicators.note: retired means the writing word goes back, read in reverse

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A youngster's inheritance of a thousand pounds was reduced, thwarted by an elderly author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' looks like it trims the thousand pounds, but it is a separate verb; 'retired' gives NEP, the writer read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The son of one's nephew or niece is a younger relation two generations down.

clue.text: Finally, pleaching a hedge was complicated for intellectual

indicators.note: was complicated signals that the letters are jumbled together
finally picks the last letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Weaving the branches of a hedge proved tricky for a thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainy, bookish person is called this informally.

clue.text: "Heard on the shore"? It's a misprint

indicators.note: heard signals a word spoken aloud that matches the sound of another

parts.note: littoral means relating to or found on the shore

explanation.surface: A printing error turns a shoreline phrase into something else.
explanation.definitionFit: In printing, a slip of a letter or character is called this.
